subject: Immediate: KV-cache safeguard maintenance (short notice) — Aug 21
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: observed transient KV corruption on a subset of us-west-2 serving nodes

Team —

Quick summary from morning telemetry: starting at ~08:57 PDT we observed a small number of generate requests returning truncated or garbled tokens across two GPU pods in us-west-2. The anomaly looks tied to a KV-cache eviction race when the runtime handled long-prefix sequences plus concurrent checkpoint flushes.

Impact: ~0.04% of requests on affected pods (priority production traffic) with short malformed completions. No data exfil or integrity loss beyond output garbling.

Proposed immediate action (30–45 minute short notice maintenance):
- Deploy a compact safeguard kernel (safeguard_patch_v1.2) that forces a KV-cache reinitialize on affected GPUs and disables the simultaneous checkpoint flush path for 30m.
- Roll to 3% canary, observe for 5 minutes, then expand to 100% in the pool.
- Provide customer notice and optional fallback to model:open-inference-v1.9 (slightly higher latency, identical semantics).

I’ve prepared the patch and mitigation steps (attached). I recommend we notify impacted customers right away and schedule a 30m window starting 09:45 PDT to execute.

Marcus
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Atlas Retail Ops <ops@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasretail.com>, csm-ops@atlasretail.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Short notice maintenance: immediate safeguard deploy for inference in us-west-2 (starts 09:45 PDT)

Hi Samir / Atlas Ops team —

We want to alert you to a short-notice, targeted maintenance window in us-west-2 that will start at 09:45 PDT today and last approximately 30 minutes. Reason: we detected a low-rate anomaly where some model responses were truncated or contained garbled tokens due to a KV-cache eviction race on a small subset of serving nodes.

What we are doing:
- Rolling a short safeguard (safeguard_patch_v1.2) that reinitializes the KV cache and temporarily disables the concurrent checkpoint flush path.
- Canary at 3% for 5 minutes, then expand.
- If you prefer, we can route your requests to a validated fallback model (open-inference-v1.9) during the window; expect ~15–25ms extra latency.

Expected impact for Atlas Retail: minimal — the change is targeted and we do not expect request failures. A small % of requests routed to a fallback model will see slightly higher latency. We will monitor your routes closely and will open an incident ticket (INC-7984) for transparency.

Attachments: mitigation-steps.pdf (recommended customer actions), safeguard_patch_v1.2.tar.gz (patch artifact; internal reference only).

If you’d like us to delay by 30 minutes to accommodate a release you have, tell us now and we’ll postpone. Otherwise, we will proceed at 09:45 PDT.

–Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasretail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Atlas Retail Ops <ops@atlasretail.com>, csm-ops@atlasretail.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:40:18 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice maintenance: immediate safeguard deploy for inference in us-west-2 (starts 09:45 PDT)

Thanks for the heads up, Naomi.

Quick questions:
1) Will any active inferences be dropped or retried during the rollout? We have a small set of batch jobs kicking off at 10:00 PDT that hit inference in bursts.
2) If we opt for the fallback model, can you confirm logits/outputs are functionally equivalent for our intents?

We prefer a 30-minute delay if it reduces the risk of affecting our 10:00 batch. If delaying isn’t feasible we’ll take the fallback route — please confirm steps.

—Samir
Senior Platform Engineer, Atlas Retail
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Atlas Retail Ops <ops@atlasretail.com>, csm-ops@atlasretail.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice maintenance: immediate safeguard deploy for inference in us-west-2 (starts 09:45 PDT)

Samir —

Thanks — we can postpone 30 minutes (new start 10:15 PDT) to avoid your 10:00 batch. We’ll hold the canary and delay the rollout. If you prefer us to proceed earlier and we’ll route your traffic to open-inference-v1.9, let me know; otherwise we’ll begin at 10:15.

Fallback model notes: open-inference-v1.9 is functionally compatible for intents and prompt semantics. You may see slightly different tokenization edge cases in <0.01% of prompts; we’ll route only when requested.

I’ll send a brief once we complete the rollout and include a post-incident summary later today.

–Naomi
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 10:25:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: observed transient KV corruption on a subset of us-west-2 serving nodes

Update: canary at 3% went green after 4m; expanded to 100% at 10:10 PDT. Post-deployment checks show no further truncated outputs across the previously affected pods. Telemetry indicates normal tokenization and KV hit-rate returned to baseline.

Next steps (postmortem):
- Engineering to capture crash-dump and timing traces for the eviction->flush window (INC-7984).
- Recommend follow-up change: small serialization barrier around checkpoint flush to remove the race condition (tracked work item).
- I’ll compile logs and attach to the ticket; expect a written post-incident summary by 15:00 PDT.

Stephanie
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Atlas Retail Ops <ops@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir.rao@atlasretail.com>, csm-ops@atlasretail.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-incident summary: KV-cache safeguard deployment (INC-7984) — Aug 21

Hi Samir / Atlas team —

Short summary of today’s event and remediation:
- What happened: a KV-cache eviction race on a small subset of us-west-2 pods caused rare truncated/garbled completions for ~0.04% of requests between ~08:57–10:10 PDT.
- What we did: deployed a short safeguard (safeguard_patch_v1.2) with a 3% canary, then full rollout; we temporarily disabled the concurrent checkpoint flush path while we validated stability.
- Impact to Atlas Retail: you opted to delay until 10:15 PDT; no customer-facing failures reported on your routes.
- Current status: resolved and monitoring; root cause investigation ongoing.

Attachments: post-incident-summary-INC-7984.pdf (contains timeline, telemetry graphs, and next action items). We’ll follow up with a technical debrief (15–30m) if you’d like to schedule one.

Apologies for the short notice and thanks for the quick coordination.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
